notes: Every video now gets a cover picture, so you can recognise a Keep at a glance. Videos you download or add from your gallery get one automatically, and older videos get theirs shortly after you open the app.
The Download video card now shows how big the video is before you tap, so you can judge your data use.
When an update is released, a pop-up appears about 10 seconds after you open Stowra, with the download size. Choose Update now or Not now.
The buttons under Video saved on this phone (Watch, Save to gallery, Remove the file) now scroll sideways so none are hidden.
